items.title: [@apireno/domshell] DOMShell: domshell_eval classified as read-tier can execute side-effecting JavaScript without --allow-write
items.summary: SummaryThe domshell_eval MCP tool (and the eval command inside domshell_execute) was classified as read-tier, allowing it to run without the --allow-write server flag. However, eval and the write-tier js command dispatch to the same handler in the extension and call CDP Runtime.evaluate with the raw expression string and no side-effect gate. Any JavaScript expression could therefore mutate DOM, window, or global state through domshell_eval without the operator's --allow-write authorization.The tool description explicitly promised "(read-only) ... always available in read-only mode" — the misclassification contradicted the documented contract, not just an implicit one.ImpactNo new capability was exposed — the same write access was already available via domshell_js with --allow-write — but the tier misclassification meant:MCP hosts (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) rendered the wrong approval UI (readOnlyHint: true)Server-side tier flags (--allow-write) misrepresented what an AI agent was actually authorized to doAudit logs and deny messages labeled write-tier activity as read-tierDownstream tools and analysis relying on the tier separation could over-trust an eval callFraming: OWASP LLM Top 10 LLM06 (Excessive Agency), NIST AI RMF (tool permission boundary + human-approval fidelity), CWE-863 (Incorrect Authorization).The reporter's main framing: the MCP approval UI and server-side permission model can misrepresent the actual agency being granted to an AI agent.Affected code pathsmcp-server/index.ts:113 — WRITE_COMMANDS excluded evalmcp-server/index.ts:879-887 — domshell_eval registered with ANNO_READ and description asserting read-onlysrc/background/index.ts:1849-1854 — js and eval both dispatch to handleJs(rawCode)src/background/index.ts:3282 — handleJs calls cdp.evaluateJs(code)src/background/cdp_client.ts:660-667 — evaluateJs sends Runtime.evaluate with expression: code, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true and no throwOnSideEffect gateFixShipped in @apireno/domshell@2.0.8 (2026-07-08):eval added to WRITE_COMMANDS, aligning tier with actual capabilitydomshell_eval MCP annotation changed from ANNO_READ to ANNO_WRITETool description and MCP_INSTRUCTIONS updated to remove read-only language; read-only DOM inspection needs pointed at domshell_cat / domshell_text / domshell_findServer-only patch — no Chrome Web Store submission required; extension code unchangedSECURITY.md added + GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting enabled on the repoUpgrade pathnpm install @apireno/domshell@2.0.8Or, in a persistent install, restart your MCP server against the new version.Drives that call eval without --allow-write will start receiving Error: 'eval' requires --allow-write. Options:Add --allow-write to the server flags if eval's write capability is actually neededMigrate read-only inspection to domshell_cat / domshell_text / domshell_findMigrate to domshell_js if the caller already runs with --allow-write (same tier, same capability)Integrator impactHKUDS/CLI-Anything — unaffected; their harness doesn't invoke eval or js commands (verified by grep).Kgspin QA-UX drives — unaffected; they run with --allow-write for their action gates.Direct Claude Desktop / Cursor sessions — any that called domshell_eval without --allow-write will now be denied, aligning behavior with the documented contract.Reporter / CreditUgur Ozer, AI Risk Managementhttps://airiskmanagement.cainfo@airiskmanagement.caSource-review-first responsible disclosure via private email to the maintainer on 2026-07-08. Reporter finding id: DOMSHELL-EVAL-READ-TIER-BYPASS-001. Ugur followed the standard disclosure ladder correctly despite the missing SECURITY.md at time of report — that gap has now been closed (repo now has SECURITY.md + GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting enabled).Timeline2026-07-08 — Report received by maintainer via private email2026-07-08 — Source-side claims verified against main at 2d63dab; fix planned2026-07-08 — @apireno/domshell@2.0.8 released to npm and the MCP registry; SECURITY.md added; GitHub PVR enabled2026-07-08 — This advisory publishedReferenceshttps://github.com/apireno/DOMShell/security/advisories/GHSA-vg83-hcp4-5qcchttps://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-75518https://github.com/apireno/DOMShell/commit/03c1d7625e220297aff0dde37613d65cfe6f9a36https://github.com/apireno/DOMShell/releases/tag/mcp-v2.0.8https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vg83-hcp4-5qcc
